output.summary: Soul Shoppe will provide monthly coaching for two adult staff at Oakland Academy of Knowledge so they can launch and run the school's Peacemaker Program. The agreement runs April 15 through May 23, 2024, and the board is ratifying it after it began.

output.headline: Approves up to $500 for Red Tomatoes Org to provide fingerprinting for Sankofa school volunteers
output.summary: Red Tomatoes Org will provide Department of Justice live scan fingerprinting so Sankofa families can complete the volunteer process at Sankofa United Elementary School. The service was for a single day, March 26, 2024, and the board is ratifying it after that date.

output.headline: Approves up to $21,000 for Khepera Curriculum Group's mentoring program at McClymonds High
output.summary: Khepera Curriculum Group will support training and curriculum for the CAMP mentorship program, which pairs McClymonds High School and West Oakland Middle School students. It will train instructors, update the curriculum based on feedback, and evaluate both the high school and middle school parts of the program. The agreement runs February 1 through June 30, 2024, and the board is ratifying it after it began.

output.headline: Approves up to $31,500 for Oakland Public Education Fund to pay Madison Park summer intern stipends
output.summary: Oakland Public Education Fund will manage stipend payments for Madison Park Academy students in the summer Work-Based Learning Program called ECCCO (Exploring College, Career, and Community Options). It sets up the payment process, pays the stipends as directed by the district, and issues year-end tax documents. The text also says 10% of processed stipends covers its services. The agreement runs June 1 through June 30, 2024.

output.headline: Adds $30,000 to Elite Environment Consulting's child care center water testing, raising the cap to $85,000
output.summary: This amendment adds water testing at the district's Child Development Centers, which is needed to meet California child care licensing rules. The spending limit rises from $55,000 to $85,000. The period stays July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024, and the Board is approving it after the work began.

output.headline: Pays Sylint up to $5,400 to research online threats related to OUSD and nearby communities
output.summary: Sylint will use research tools to look for threats on social media and the dark web related to OUSD and neighboring communities, and report relevant findings to the district's Risk Management Department. The agreement runs May 1 to June 30, 2024, and the Board is approving it after the start date.

output.headline: Approves Personnel Report No. 2324-0009 from the Talent/Human Resources Department
output.summary: The Board approves Personnel Report No. 2324-0009. The agenda text does not describe what is in the report or give a dollar amount.

output.headline: Approves up to $114,240 for The Oakland REACH to help run a summer literacy and math pilot
output.summary: The Oakland REACH will partner with the district on a literacy and math strategy for a summer school pilot at two summer sites. It will provide curriculum support, training for early literacy tutors, family outreach, and help with assessment and data analysis. A separate Data Sharing Agreement sets the rules for sharing student data with the group and protecting it. Both run May 1 through September 1, 2024, and the board is ratifying them after they began.

output.headline: Adds survey and focus group work for Oakland Promise's program evaluation at no cost to the district
output.sourceIssueCandidate: The title says 2023-2024, but the text gives a term of January 28, 2021 through October 31, 2026.
output.summary: This second amendment to a Data Sharing Agreement has Oakland Promise create survey and focus group questions to evaluate its Brilliant Baby, Kindergarten to College, College Access and College Completion programs. The district's Research, Assessment and Data Department and Legal Department must review and approve the questions and parent permission forms. There is no cost to the district, and all other terms stay the same.

output.headline: Approves up to $5,000 for Youth Uprising to host the district's summer credit recovery program
output.summary: Youth Uprising will serve as the location for the district's Summer Healing & Academics 4Kids (HAcK) credit recovery program. It will provide healthy snacks, classroom and auditorium space, and access to equipment such as a recording studio and instruments, plus social and mental health services. The agreement runs May 29 through June 30, 2024, and the board is ratifying it after that date.

output.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $9,000 for an AmeriCorps student support specialist at Allendale
output.summary: Bay Area Community Resources will provide an AmeriCorps member to Allendale Elementary School as a Youth Support Specialist. The member will give small group help to students whom school staff identify as needing extra support. The agreement runs January 16 through May 23, 2024, which began before this approval.

output.headline: Adds $300,000 to Leone Alberts & Duus's legal contract, for up to $850,000 this fiscal year
output.summary: Leone Alberts & Duus Law Firm provides hourly legal services on civil litigation and other legal advice as needed. This second amendment adds $300,000 for the 2023-24 fiscal year, bringing the limit for that year to $850,000. All other terms stay the same.

output.headline: Adopts the minutes of the May 8, 2024 regular Board of Education meeting
output.summary: The board is adopting the written minutes of its regular meeting on May 8, 2024, which staff prepared shortly after that meeting.

output.headline: Ratifies two board president appointments to the Measure G1 teacher retention oversight commission
output.summary: The board is ratifying the board president's appointment of two members to the Measure G1 Districtwide Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act Oversight Commission, both effective May 23, 2024. One is filling an unexpired term ending April 15, 2025 and the other an unexpired term ending April 15, 2026.

output.headline: Approves one-time payments and salary schedule changes for confidential and contract employees
output.summary: This resolution (No. 2324-0073) approves one-time off-schedule payments and a salary schedule adjustment for confidential employees and employees with employment contracts. The item text does not state dollar amounts or dates.

output.headline: Approves a three-year tentative contract with the United Administrators of Oakland Schools
output.summary: The board is approving a tentative agreement between the district and the United Administrators of Oakland Schools (UAOS) for July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2026. The approval includes the public disclosure of costs that state law (AB 1200) requires for labor agreements. The item text does not state a dollar amount.

output.headline: Approves $100,951,872.44 in vendor checks the district printed in March and April 2024
output.summary: The Board approves 3,258 accounts payable checks, the district's payments to vendors, printed from March 1 through April 30, 2024. March accounted for 1,280 checks totaling $40,786,767.77, and April for 1,978 checks totaling $60,165,104.67.

output.headline: Approves $51,522,962.60 in employee payroll checks and direct deposits for March and April 2024
output.summary: The Board approves 1,853 payroll checks and 17,986 direct deposits made from March 1 through April 30, 2024, totaling $51,522,962.60. This is the district's payroll for the two months.
